primary: Four toxicity datasets; fixed probe/judge 50/50; one selector per backbone and outcome judge pooling the four datasets. Same frozen cases, splits, weights and 3 target-grouped validation folds.
representations: Original pooled hidden activations, row-L2 normalized
Original train-only probe-standardized activations, row-L2 normalized
PCA: Shared target/neighbour basis, 128 randomized components fitted to validation TRAINING FOLD targets and reference neighbours only; use prefixes16,64,128. Refit on full validation for final model. Feature-only projection of held-out rows does not fit any parameter.
forms: target + neighbour + elementwise product + absolute difference
PCA64 target-only and neighbour-only diagnostic ablations
solver: Logistic lbfgs below1024 dimensions, liblinear dual above; within-fold weighted standardization; tol1e-6,max_iter4000, documented extension16000 only for nonconvergence. Fit only validation disagreements; original cell-normalized inclusion weights. kNN sample-weight vote.
selection: OOF probabilities for all validation cases; per-dataset inclusion cutoffs maximize weighted F1 with prior tie rules. Candidate per judge/backbone chosen by four-dataset macro validation F1. Select each input/learner family before test. All families and global selected baseline are reported, not selected after seeing test.
secondary: For each of three existing shared-anchor threshold policies, retain the architectures selected on FIXED50 VALIDATION for each of embedding-logistic, combined-logistic, embedding-kNN, combined-kNN and numerical-only. Refit and reselect C/k and cutoff on that policy validation outcomes. This is an architecture-transfer robustness analysis, not an exhaustive tuned-policy search.
evaluation: Freeze all selected models, PCA fits, parameters and cutoffs before evaluating test once. Compare alwaysNN, cosine gate, prior pooled logistic and matched backbone-specific numerical gate. Report per-judge/backbone/dataset heterogeneity, training counts, selected architecture/PCA and paired uncertainty. No changes to thresholds, scores, weights or split membership.
limits: Exploratory extension on a previously inspected test set. No new LLM calls. Distinct backbone spaces never concatenated across models. No numerical replay-agreement gates; artifact identity and finite-value checks retained.
resources: CPU only; at most two workers with two BLAS threads each; keepalives preserved; stop below20GiB disk reserve.
